text: Cimon smiled and asked him whether he wished to have Cimon's hired service or his friendship. He replied, his friendship. "If so," said he, "take away these pieces, for being your friend, when I shall have occasion for them, I will send and ask for them."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Cimon
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
